import pandas as pd

# Load all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# According to operation_history:
# 1) Join Source9_28_3 with Source9_28_0 on ROW_WID
df = pd.merge(source3, source0, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# 2) Join the result with Source9_28_1 on ROW_WID
df = pd.merge(df, source1, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# 3) Join the result with Source9_28_2 on ROW_WID
df = pd.merge(df, source2, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# 4) Group by [] (no grouping columns) and aggregate avg(Source9_28_3.ARPU)
# Since group_by is empty, this means compute the average ARPU over all rows
# The target schema is ['ARPU': float], so output a dataframe with one column ARPU and one row with the average

avg_arpu = df["ARPU"].mean()

target_df = pd.DataFrame({"ARPU": [avg_arpu]})

# Save the result to the specified path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSVs with index_col=0 as instructed
s0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
s1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
s2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
s3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
s4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
s5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_5.csv", index_col=0)
s6 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_6.csv", index_col=0)
s7 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_7.csv", index_col=0)
s8 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_8.csv", index_col=0)
s9 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/training_9.csv", index_col=0)

# Union the dimension tables with same schema (s3, s5, s6, s7)
dim_tables = [s3, s5, s6, s7]
unioned_dim = pd.concat(dim_tables, ignore_index=True)

# Join unioned_dim with s0, s1, s2, s4 on ROW_WID
df = unioned_dim.merge(s0, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")
df = df.merge(s1, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")
df = df.merge(s2, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")
df = df.merge(s4, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Join with s8 and s9 on ROW_WID
df = df.merge(s8, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")
df = df.merge(s9, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# The target schema is ['ARPU'] only, so select ARPU column
# Since no keys or group by columns exist in target, just aggregate average ARPU
result = pd.DataFrame({"ARPU": [df["ARPU"].mean()]})

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_28/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
